descriptionHtml:
Retrofitted Bridge (v0.0.4)Convert automated ships to crewed ships.
download hererequires LunaLib                 
This mods does 2 things
  • Allows you to salvage automated ships without the automated ships skill (but you still can't deploy them effectively because of the CR penalty).
  • You can instead, for a substantial credit cost, replace the automated ship hullmod with retrofitted bridge, which turns it into a crewed ship.
